Print a RLT object

Source: R/print.r
print.RLT.Rd

Print a RLT object

Usage

# S3 method for class 'RLT'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted RLT object

...

...

Examples

# \donttest{
set.seed(42)
x <- matrix(rnorm(100 * 5), ncol = 5)
y <- rowSums(x[, 1:2]) + rnorm(100)
fit <- RLT(x, y, ntrees = 50)
print(fit)
#> ------------------------------------------
#> RLT Regression Forest
#> ------------------------------------------
#>               (N, P) = (100, 5)
#>           # of trees = 50
#>         (mtry, nmin) = (2, 5)
#>       split generate = Best
#>             sampling = 100% w/ replace
#>           importance = none
#>             OOB MSE = 1.4062 (R2 = 0.4623)
#> ------------------------------------------
# }
